name: Pikachu

abilities.name: static
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: lightning-rod
abilities.effect: Redirects single-target electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

genderDifference: Female's tail ends in the upper half of a heart

kanto.flavorText: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

original-johto.flavorText: When it is anger­ ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

hoenn.flavorText: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.

updated-johto.flavorText: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

original-unova.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

updated-unova.flavorText: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

kalos.flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: This Pokémon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.

original-alola.flavorText: It’s in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it’s unable to fully discharge the electricity.

updated-alola.flavorText: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it’s not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.

swsh.flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they’ll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

pla.flavorText: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
